title: Peptigrity Purity Index
description:
Recency-weighted HPLC purity of research peptides, one row per compound, aggregated from independent third-party laboratory tests indexed by Peptigrity.

Live data, updated daily: https://peptigrity.com/purity-index. This record is a dated quarterly snapshot. Method, thresholds and weights are documented on the live page.

The dataset describes the samples that were tested, not the whole market, and contains no shop, vendor or batch identifiers.
